notes.title: Nominate us for the Labor of Love Steam Award!
notes.content:
[h1]Nominate us for the Labor of Love Steam Award![/h1]
[i]Detroit: Become Human[/i] has captured hearts with its emotional storytelling, complex characters, and unforgettable choices. Releasing the game on Steam in 2020 and seeing the community grow and getting so much positive feedback has been amazing – thank you for your continuous support! 

If you've been touched by Connor, Kara, and Markus' journeys, please don't hesitate to cast your vote to get [i]Detroit: Become Human[/i] nominated for the [b]Labor of Love[/b] category in the [b]Steam Awards 2024[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37885696/a02951aa686f50236157c2f8986e13f56a60e427.jpg[/img]

[h1]How to Vote:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Visit the Steam Awards page
[*] Go to the Labor of Love category
[*] Select [i]Detroit: Become Human[/i] and cast your vote!
[/list]

And if you haven't played the game yet, it is currently 70% off on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222140/Detroit_Become_Human/

Thank you, 
The Quantic Dream Team
